message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, giving you a 3‑day weekend).  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., Family Day in Alberta vs. British Columbia—just let me know and I can break it down further.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Family Day was on Monday, Feb 20. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | Good Friday was on Friday, Apr 7. |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day was on Monday, May 22. |
| **Jun 30 – Jul 2** | Canada Day | Canada Day fell on Saturday, Jul 1. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | Labour Day was on Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving was on Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day was on Friday, Nov 11. |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas | Christmas was on Monday, Dec 25. |

### How to use this in your app
1. **Store the dates** in a simple array or database table.  
2. **Flag the holiday** as a “long weekend” so your UI can highlight it.  
3. If you want to support province‑specific holidays, add a `province` field and filter accordingly.

Let me know if you’d like the list broken out by province or if you need any other holiday data!
